changelog: Big Battery Win: The live wallpaper is now static and redraws only once a minute instead of 30 times a second — far less drain, same look

Wallpaper Master Switch: Turn the whole wallpaper system on or off from Settings — just tap your avatar in the top bar. It ships OFF by default, so Odyssey never draws in the background unless you ask it to
Wallpaper Corrected: Placeholder habits no longer show your real streak number beside a habit you haven't created, and damaged saved wallpaper settings now recover instead of silently resetting
Category Labels Now Consistent: A task tagged "Work" and one tagged "work" are treated as the same everywhere, so filtering, colours and the wallpaper stop disagreeing

Reliability & Speed: 77 failure points that failed silently now report what actually went wrong, and roughly 600 lines of duplicated code were consolidated — fewer surprises, less wasted battery, faster launches
